messages:
Sam: Quick note from user interviews 10 people7: the compare tables badges are too attention-grabbing. People think badges are primary data instead of quick signals.
Rina: I saw that too. Could we de-emphasize visually (smaller, muted background) and provide a single summary pill for extra metrics that expands inline?
Carlos: Summary pill sounds nice: show top metric icons + a compact "+n" pill. On click expand just below the row with metric name + value. Keeps rows tidy.
Mina: Pin scope confusion again: users expect pinning to respect current filters. Its currently global and they lose context, which caused errors in two tasks.
Sam: Proposal: when pinning show a small modal: "Pin model version as: [Global] [Current search]". Default to current search but allow global with explanation.
Rina: Alternative lighter-weight: toast "Pinned v4.1 globally" with a secondary CTA "Apply to current search". Less intrusive but still informative.
Carlos: Also add a persistent header pill: "Pinned: v4.1" that links to pin settings. That helps when filters change and users lose sight of the pinned state.
Mina: Accessibility notes: color + icon only is risky. Ensure text fallback and aria-live updates when pin changes. Hit target: visual 18-20px ok but interactive area must be 32px.
Sam: Motion: animate pin -> header pill with a short slide/fade. Users noticed the action in tests when we did any animation. Make it subtle and performant (no layout thrash).
Rina: Badge contrast: current gray on light gray fails AA at small sizes. Use stronger contrast or inset outline. Also ensure badges have meaningful aria-labels like "Throughput: 12k r/s - good".
Carlos: Overflow behavior: on small widths collapse non-primary badges into a single "Details" control. On desktop show first two badges + "+n". On expand, keyboard should focus the first item.
Mina: Keyboard order fix: make sure row actions are reachable before badge expansion so keyboard users don't accidentally open popovers when tabbing. Test with NVDA + VoiceOver.
QA-Bot: Reminder: add test cases for pin persistence across filter changes, badge hit-targets, and toast undo for pin/unpin.
Sam: Next steps: Rina to mock compact badges + summary pill, Carlos to add pin-scope microcopy options, Mina to draft a11y acceptance, QA-Bot to add tests. We'll sync Friday 9:30.
